title: Depost AI
lede: Depost AI is a LinkedIn agent that ranks each of your past posts against your own average, then plans, writes and designs a month of posts and publishes the ones you approve.

points: Scores every published post against your own baseline to show which formats and topics land with your audience.
Plans the month from those results and from what is winning in your niche, drawing on 150k+ viral posts the team analysed.
Writes in your voice, designs the graphic, and publishes through LinkedIn's official API only after approval.
Finds what prospects posted and drafts replies; runs in its own app or inside Claude and ChatGPT over MCP.

sections.text: Founders and teams growing on LinkedIn, and agencies: each client gets its own brand and audited approvals, and clients, VAs and teammates join free.
Monthly plans start at $59 with a 7-day free trial. A Black Friday lifetime deal costs $399 once and runs until 31 December.
